+import pytest
+
+from netutil.retry import retry
+
+
+def test_returns_on_first_success_without_sleeping():
+    sleeps = []
+
+    @retry(sleep=sleeps.append)
+    def ok():
+        return 7
+
+    assert ok() == 7
+    assert sleeps == []
+
+
+def test_backoff_schedule_and_no_sleep_after_final_attempt():
+    sleeps = []
+    calls = []
+
+    @retry(attempts=4, exceptions=(ValueError,), base_delay=0.1, factor=2.0, sleep=sleeps.append)
+    def always_fails():
+        calls.append(1)
+        raise ValueError("boom")
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        always_fails()
+    assert len(calls) == 4
+    assert sleeps == pytest.approx([0.1, 0.2, 0.4])
+
+
+def test_reraises_last_exception_unchanged():
+    errors = []
+
+    @retry(attempts=2, exceptions=(KeyError,), sleep=lambda s: None)
+    def fail():
+        exc = KeyError(len(errors))
+        errors.append(exc)
+        raise exc
+
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError) as info:
+        fail()
+    assert info.value is errors[-1]
+
+
+def test_unlisted_exception_propagates_immediately():
+    calls = []
+    sleeps = []
+
+    @retry(attempts=3, exceptions=(ValueError,), sleep=sleeps.append)
+    def wrong_type():
+        calls.append(1)
+        raise TypeError("nope")
+
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        wrong_type()
+    assert len(calls) == 1
+    assert sleeps == []
+
+
+def test_preserves_name_and_doc():
+    @retry()
+    def documented():
+        """Doc text."""
+
+    assert documented.__name__ == "documented"
+    assert documented.__doc__ == "Doc text."
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("attempts", [0, -1])
+def test_invalid_attempts_raise_at_decoration_time(attempts):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        retry(attempts=attempts)
